# Reverend Jo

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009)</sub>
- **Origin:** St. Columbia  <sub>[v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009)</sub>
- **Role:** minister / clergyman  <sub>[v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 c24 P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039)</sub>
- **Titles:** Rev.  <sub>[v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Jo  <sub>[v3 c27 P21](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0021)</sub>

## Appearance

He is described as a very ugly young man with a big, loose-jointed figure and absurdly long legs. He has tow-colored, lank hair, green eyes, a large mouth, and notable ears. Despite his plain appearance, he is radiant in his happiness on his wedding day so that nobody considers him plain.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 c24 P10](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0010), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039)_

## Personality

He is pleasant, friendly, and exhales niceness. He enjoys laughing and joking, which makes him a general favorite at Patty's Place though some older ladies disapprove of his jovial demeanor. He is able to make up his mind quickly and offers thoughtful advice to others.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c25 P12](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0012), [v3 c27 P25](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0025)_

## Traits

- jovial and friendly  <sub>[v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c25 P12](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0012)</sub>
- decisive  <sub>[v3 c27 P25](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0025)</sub>

## Abilities

- giving sound rule and advice  <sub>[v3 c27 P25](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0025)</sub>

## Goals

- to do the work given to him as a minister  <sub>[v3 c24 P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019)</sub>

## History

Jonas Blake graduated from Redmond College and spent time in St. Columbia as a theological student. During one summer, he took charge of the Point Prospect Mission Church, where he met Philippa Gordon and spent his leisure time fishing, boating, and walking on the sands with her. He frequently traveled from St. Columbia to visit Patty's Place, where he became a favorite guest. Although he missed social engagements to lead prayer meetings in the slums, he eventually proposed to Phil Gordon and was accepted. After meeting Phil's family at Mount Holly and winning their affection, they were married the following June.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c25 P12](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0012), [v3 c26 P6](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0006), [v3 c27 P19](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0019), [v3 c35 P10](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0010), [v3 c38 P5](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0005), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039)_

## Quotes

> No, I couldn’t. I tried to be something else for a long time—I didn’t want to be a minister. But I came to see at last that it was the work given me to do—and God helping me, I shall try to do it.  <sub>[v3 c24 P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019)</sub>
